competences.description: Attacks all enemies to inflict Continuous Damage for 2 turns.

Grants Reflect Harmful Effect on itself for 2 turns, and then attacks all enemies 3 times. Each hit grants Silence on enemies with no harmful effects for 2 turns with a 50% chance. Gains 1 stack of Chaos Force whenever attacking an enemy granted with Continuous Damage.

Attacks all enemies. Gains 5 stacks of Chaos Force if the boss attacks an enemy granted with a harmful effect. When attacking enemies granted with Continuous Damage, Chaos Force increases by the number of those enemies.

Decreases the HP of all enemies by 1% per stack of Chaos Force, and then attacks all enemies with an attack that ignores all damage reduction effects. The damage dealt increases by 1% per stack of Chaos Force. This attack does not activate passive skills of the enemies.
